{{Quote|Miners. They're wearing mining suits. The Empire's digging something valuable out of this planet, and the CIrcarpousians don't know a thing about it.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="SotME" />}}
'''Mining suits''' were a type of [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] worn by [[miner]]s throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were made of black, reflective material that tucked into high black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The suit also included a hood that would fastenform to fit the head of the wearer, or could be removed and folded flat against the suit's upper back.<ref name="SotME" />
